# GitHub Automation Agent Instructions

Follow [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).

For changes under `.github/`, read only the relevant references:

- Build, dependency, test, or Pages changes: [`../docs/AI_BUILD_NOTES.md`](../docs/AI_BUILD_NOTES.md)
- Distribution, tags, manifests, or release publication: [`../docs/AI_RELEASE_NOTES.md`](../docs/AI_RELEASE_NOTES.md)

Do not tag, publish, dispatch, change permissions, or modify repository settings without explicit authorization. Keep the release whitelist and the separate GitHub Pages deployment model intentional.
